note.p: This topic contains instructions for Conga CLM (Contracts for Salesforce) users.

conbody.p: Clause Library contains clauses and clause bundles that can be reused across multiple agreement templates. Clause Library helps you to search for clauses or clause bundles that can be inserted into templates as inline text. You cannot use the Clause Library to insert clauses unless the template you are working with has already been checked in at least once. If you are in the process of creating a new template, check in the template and open it again to start using Clause Library.
Using Clause Library, you can perform the following actions:

link.linktext: Inserting Clause Bundles into a Template
